title: Laptop

  <path d='M12 58 h76 l6 12 a4 4 0 0 1 -4 5 h-80 a4 4 0 0 1 -4 -5 z' fill='#b8cbe6'/>

  <path d='M12 58 h76 l1 3 h-78 z' fill='#d6e4f5'/>
